overviewHtml:
When Sentinel reports an intrusion on a VM, every minute of delay gives an attacker more room, and manual isolation risks losing forensic evidence.

What you get

  • Resource locks, disabled managed identities and blocked anonymous blob access on the VM
  • An isolation network security group that blocks all traffic except an allow-list
  • A separate investigation resource group with its own network
  • Snapshots of OS and data disks and an investigation VM with the copies attached
prereqsHtml:
• Dynatrace SaaS with Workflows
  • Azure for Workflows with a connection that may manage compute, network, storage, locks and role assignments in the subscription
  • Microsoft Sentinel alerts ingested into Dynatrace (the trigger listens for event.provider == "Microsoft Sentinel" on virtual machines)
  • An SSH key pair for the investigation VM
setupHtml:
1. Optional: create a test VM. In the Azure portal, create a resource group (for example demo-incident-workflow) and a VM (for example vulnerable-vm) with any region and size. Choose password authentication and set Public inbound ports to None. Copy the subscription ID.
  2. Upload all four templates in Workflows:
  • azure-security-incident-workflow-parent.workflow-template.yaml
  • azure-security-investigation-incident-rg-networking.workflow-template.yaml
  • azure-security-investigation-isolate-vulnerable-vm.workflow-template.yaml
  • azure-security-investigation-snapshot-disks-and-vm.workflow-template.yaml

Select your Azure connection in each one.

  1. Link the sub-workflows in the parent. For example, isolate_vulnerable_vm must point to Azure Security Investigation - Isolate Vulnerable VM.
  2. Add your SSH public key in the public_ssh_keys task of Snapshot, Disks, and VM.
  3. Test it. In the parent workflow, choose Run with this example event:
   {
     "azure.subscription": "<YOUR_SUBSCRIPTION_ID>",
     "azure.resource.group": "<YOUR_RESOURCE_GROUP>",
     "azure.resource.name": "<YOUR_VM_NAME>"
   }

After a successful run, Azure has a new incident-workflow resource group with the investigation VM, the disk snapshots, an isolation NSG and the cloned disks.
getStartedHtml:
You need Dynatrace Workflows, Azure for Workflows and Sentinel alerts ingested into Dynatrace.

  1. Upload the parent workflow and its three sub-workflows
  2. Select your Azure connection and link the sub-workflows
  3. Add the SSH public key for the investigation VM
  4. Test with an example event for a non-production VM
